name: multirotate
description: Provider that rotates a cursor over a fixed number of timestamps on a time basis, for periodic credential rotation.

nodejs.packageDescription: A Pulumi provider that rotates a cursor over a fixed number of timestamps on a time basis, for periodic credential rotation.

multirotate:index:MultiRotate.description: Rotates credentials. It maintains `timestamps` and an `index` into them; when the timestamp at `index` is older than `rotationPeriodDays`, the cursor advances to the next slot and that slot is re-stamped with the current time.

count.description: Number of timestamps in the rotation window.

rotationPeriodDays.description: Number of days a timestamp stays valid before it is rotated.
